reviewed_policy.route: Any original sra node with in0/in1 anywhere in its second (shift) operand subtree AND BOTH addi and xori anywhere in its first (data) operand subtree.
reviewed_policy.median: numpy.median of all300 scalar tree predictions from existing1825forest, on217mappingfeatures; for even300, arithmetic mean of sorted positions149and150 (zero-based). This is not equivalent to strict-majority cap voting.
reviewed_policy.formula: Start with frozen budget_release_compound_only. On compound route, find each cap in[32,64,128] for which incumbent_signed<=cap<release AND forest_median<=cap. If any, return smallest qualifying cap; otherwise return release. Outside compound route return release exactly.
reviewed_policy.decisions: Accept iff point<=cap, inclusive. Exact cap values, no floating tolerance in inference or cap decisions.
reviewed_policy.selection: One fixed candidate; eligible for fresh promotion only if every development gate passes. No alternative selection, extra fits, parameter search or postlabel changes.
reviewed_policy.inputs: Original AST, explicit cached336features, frozen forest outputs and fixed caps only. No labels, IDs, predicted errors, normalized formulas or case lookup in inference.
reviewed_policy.interpretation: Parameter-free but informed by consumed development evidence. Correlated tree predictions and their median do not provide calibrated uncertainty or universal hardware safety.

reviewed_gates.retained: Each complete nine consumed panels and prior named subgroups: MAE and positive-target MAPE <=budget_release_compound_only; FA<=budget_release_compound_only and FR<=incumbent_signed separately at each32/64/128; maximum underprediction<=both comparators; incumbent_signed<=point<=release and exact release elsewhere.
reviewed_gates.named_failure: Consumed fifth-fresh40 index12 (fixed by frozen candidate manifest for evaluation only) actual125 and release>128; repaired point<=128. No inference lookup.
reviewed_gates.fresh: Complete40: MAE and MAPE strictly<incumbent_signed AND <=budget_release_compound_only; FA<=release and FR<=signed separately percap32/64/128; strictly fewer summed FA circuit-budget events than signed; maximum underprediction<=release and signed. Fresh compound subset MAE/MAPE<=release and all cap/tail gates. At least one fresh point must change versus release, so repair transfer is exercised. Development eligibility required.
reviewed_gates.missing: All preregistered rows retained; missing/failed features or labels blocks eligibility. No retries, replacements, fits, cohort filtering or criterion changes.
